name: CEF 149.0.6 (proprietary codecs)
body:
Chromium Embedded Framework **149.0.6** (chromium 149.0.7827.201) built **with proprietary codecs** (H.264/AAC) so WhatsApp MP4 audio/video plays. Includes the Karere #151 idle-CPU patch.

Minimal distributions for linux64 (x86_64) and linuxarm64 (aarch64). C-API compatible with the `cef` crate `149.3.0+149.0.6`.

> Distributing H.264/AAC binaries carries patent-licensing obligations that fall on whoever hosts/redistributes them.

name: CEF 148.0.10 proprietary-codecs (#151 idle-CPU fix)
body:
Proprietary-codec (H.264/AAC) CEF build for Karere, chromium-148.0.7778.218 / cef g7ee53f5.

Identical to cef-148.0.10-proprietary-codecs except libcef.so carries the Karere #151 patch (tools/cef-patches/karere-151-detach-worksource.patch): detaches the unused glib WorkSource installed by CEF's external message pump, which otherwise pinned one CPU core at 100% whenever the app was idle/backgrounded.

Only libcef.so differs from the prior release; all other distrib files are byte-identical.

name: v3.0.2 - Call Fix (Flathub compatible)
body:
## What's Fixed

- **Calls**: Voice and video calls now work in the production Flatpak on Flathub. The previous v3.0.1 approach (building gst-plugin-audiofx from source with cargo) failed Flathub's manifest linter due to `git`/`shell` source types not being supported. The plugin is now pre-compiled and distributed as a binary release asset (same approach as WebKitGTK).

## Upgrading

- From v3.0.0 or v3.0.1: drop-in update, no re-authentication required.
- From v2.x: re-linking your WhatsApp account is required on first launch.

name: v3.0.1 - Call Fix
body:
## What's Fixed

- **Calls**: Voice and video calls now work in the production Flatpak. The `gst-plugin-audiofx` module (providing the `audiornnoise` GStreamer element required by WebKitGTK's WebRTC audio pipeline) was missing from the production manifest — it was only included in the development build. This caused calls to fail with "GStreamer element audiornnoise not found" in the production release.

## Upgrading from v3.0.0

This is a drop-in patch — no re-authentication required if you already upgraded to v3.0.0.

If upgrading directly from v2.x, you will need to re-link your WhatsApp account(s). A one-time dialog will explain this on first launch.

name: v3.0.0 - Voice & Video Calls
body:
## Breaking Change

Upgrading to v3.0.0 requires re-linking your WhatsApp account(s). A dialog will explain this on first launch. This is a one-time step caused by the new WebKitGTK build.

## What's New

### Voice & Video Calls
Full WebRTC support is now enabled via a custom WebKitGTK 2.50.5 build. Calls were previously blocked because the GNOME Platform 50 runtime ships WebKitGTK with WebRTC disabled.

### Bug Fixes
- **Downloads** (#127, #110): Files now save with WhatsApp's original filename; duplicate downloads auto-increment (e.g. `photo (1).jpg`) instead of failing
- **Window** (#125): Window now properly unminimizes when activated from the GNOME app launcher or system tray
- **Notification Volume** (#124): Notification sounds now respect GNOME's volume controls and per-app volume settings

### Other Changes
- User agent updated to Firefox 148 on Linux
- Removed blob→data: URL download workaround (WebKitGTK 2.50.x handles blob downloads natively)
- PipeWire environment variables that caused UI freeze on call initiation have been removed
- Added `en_GB` locale (renamed from incorrect `en_UK`)
- All 8 translations fully updated
